meta.combat_note: combat.gd is deterministic; variance is seeded build/box generation only
meta.kit_note: kit runs: free repairs, satchel purse per fight tier won, Gleaner's Due spill on death, box grade balanced across Dud..Gleaming
meta.ladder_note: each rung is an independent full-HP bout (foe aims_core=false); climb stops at first non-WIN; stake charged per rung
meta.read_only_note: no PlayerState save / user:// access; fresh ManabitState + RunState per session
meta.tier_note: novice=shipped greedy AI + cheap builds; average=best-damage + focus-break + guard-when-behind + mid builds; expert=core-aiming lens + strong builds
meta.venture_note: own-build ventures pay NO purse (KIT_PURSE is kit-only); net scrap = forfeit salvage + gleaners wreck - repairs
